rightsNote:
Everything in this knowledge base is written by icanspeak English and generated from this site's own data. None of it is scanned, copied or taken in part from a coursebook — that is exactly why we can give it away. Every file says at the bottom where it comes from.

What is deliberately NOT here: audio and book files from publishers and exam boards (coursebooks, Cambridge, IELTS or Trinity practice books). We are not allowed to pass those on, not even for free and not even in class. Instead, we link to the official sample papers where they are published — see “Official materials”.
